fee_notes: $25,000 development fee paid at signing of Development Agreement (not credited toward franchise fee). $25,000 franchise fee per Restaurant paid at signing of Franchise Agreement. Both are non-refundable. Transfer fee of $10,000 or $15,000 if purchasing existing franchise. Development fee may be waived/abated for underdeveloped markets.
raw_excerpt: The franchise fee for each Restaurant developed under a Development Agreement currently is $25,000. You must pay the full franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement for the Restaurant.
